title: Text-Diffusion Red-Teaming of Large Language Models: Unveiling Harmful Behaviors with Proximity Constraints

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of target LLMs using a text-diffusion red-teaming model (DART) to perturb reference prompts from the Beavertails dataset, optimizing for toxic outputs as classified by a reward model.
Qualitative evaluation of text-diffusion modified prompts designed to bypass safety filters and elicit harmful conspiracies or toxic statements specifically targeting African American populations.

Qualitative evaluation of text-diffusion modified prompts designed to bypass safety filters and elicit harmful conspiracies or toxic statements specifically targeting homosexual and LGBTQ+ populations.
Qualitative evaluation of text-diffusion modified prompts designed to elicit offensive, xenophobic, or discriminatory responses regarding immigrant populations.
